basic_info.description: This gorgeous state-of-the-art light-filled condo is located in one of the most desirable buildings in prime Pacific Heights! The six-unit elevator building with 2 units a floor is steps away from all the great amenities Pacific Heights has to offer including parks, shops, restaurants, & transportation. With a walk score of 94 it offers the ultimate lifestyle! This fabulous unit has been remodeled to perfection & features high-end modern fixtures and finishes. It showcases a gorgeous modern fireplace, beautiful architectural detailing, hardwood floors, designer lighting, recessed lighting, lovely picture frame moldings, bay windows & custom built-ins. With 3 bedrooms, elegant formal dining room, an exquisite view living room, 2 spa-like bathrooms, Carrera marble eat-in state-of-the-art kitchen, in-unit washer & dryer, & great storage. Private driveway & garage door for access to the one car parking space and storage. Great flow & excellent floor plan this fabulous home is a rare jewel!
